measurement: Warmed, fresh-context prompt processing through the first generated token

hardware.selection: Separate processes pinned by full GPU UUID; private host identifiers omitted.

workload.description: Original CC0 synthetic garden ledger and Python arithmetic code, generated from 1024 numbered records
workload.preparation: Vocab-only libllama CPU tokenization, add_special=false, parse_special=true; prefix slices of one tokenization
workload.reproduction: prefill_bench.py --backend prepare; GPU tokenizer reproduction matched all measured token IDs exactly
workload.token_hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON integer array with separators=(',', ':')

llama.cache_policy: Erase owned slot 0 before every request; cache_prompt=false and cache-ram=0

megakernel.cache_policy: Reset engine and verify empty sequence before every request

settings.aggregation: For each input length, total evaluated input tokens divided by total measured seconds; no best-of

timing_scopes.llama: Native prompt_ms through synchronized first-token sampling in available server source; exact source/build correspondence unverified because binary version is unknown.
timing_scopes.megakernel: Python perf_counter around synchronous Engine.prefill: includes ctypes conversion, vector copy, N-1 batched tokens, last persistent-kernel step, lm-head/sample, checkpoint work and initial draft setup.
timing_scopes.comparison: Not identical timer scopes, pure-kernel performance, or end-to-end HTTP time-to-first-token

limitations: Cross-card measurements with different timer overheads; ratios describe these measured paths, not isolated kernels.
One synthetic workload with three timed repetitions per input length; clocks and other host/GPU load can vary.
No KLD, generated-output quality, long-context quality, or universal performance claim.
